items.description: Laptop replacement - equivalent to the damaged model (repair uneconomic per supplier report)
items.rationale: Policy 2.6 and 7.1.10: Sudden accidental damage to portable equipment is covered, and the battery health waiver means the laptop is not excluded by 2.6.8. The replacement is capped at the cost of an equivalent model, not the higher-spec chosen (7.1.9). Reference Case 22 (screen and corner repair t < 313, but here full replacement is justified), so t is set at a moderate market value for a mainstream laptop replacement.

items.description: Higher-spec upgrade difference (better model than the one damaged)
items.rationale: Policy 7.1.9: No betterment over pre-loss standard; only the equivalent model is indemnified. The upgrade cost is excluded.

items.description: Tablet screen repair (struck in the same bag)
items.rationale: Policy 2.6 and 7.1.10: Sudden accidental damage to portable equipment is covered. The tablet was damaged in the same event, so repair is indemnified up to a fair market rate for a screen replacement. Reference Case 22 (screen repair t < 313), so a moderate value is used.
Policy 5.2.3: Diagnostic costs for damaged portable equipment are covered up to EUR 250 per event. Both devices were affected in the same event, so a single charge is indemnified within the cap.

items.description: New laptop carry bag (not damaged in the incident)
items.rationale: Policy 7.1.5 and 7.1.8: Only items actually damaged by the insured event are covered. The bag was not damaged, so this is excluded.

items.description: Extended warranty on the replacement laptop
items.rationale: Policy 3.5(f) and 7.1.8(e): Extended warranties and future service contracts are expressly excluded from cover.

items.description: Data recovery from the damaged laptop drive
items.rationale: Policy 3.5(d) and 4.3(c): Data recovery and restoration are not covered unless specifically endorsed, which is not the case here.
Policy 3.5(d) and 4.3(c): Administration fees for data recovery are not covered unless specifically endorsed, which is not the case here.
